'''Shove-Off Point''' was a shantytown in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. [[The Drall]], a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], lived there.
